description_en: Queries the port details of cloud service instances that are connected to WAF
description_zh: 查询已接入WAF的云产品实例端口详情
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-cloud-resource-access-port-details --instance-id waf-cn-tl32ast0000 --resource-instance-id lb-2zeugkfj81jvo00004tqm --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeCloudResourceAccessPortDetails

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.
You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html，查看当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the resource
parameters.name: resource_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The port of the cloud service that is connected to WAF
parameters.name: port

parameters.help_en: The page number of the list. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页的行数。默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The cloud service type. Valid values:

clb4: Layer 4 CLB.

clb7: Layer 7 CLB.

ecs: ECS.
nlb: NLB
parameters.help_zh:
云产品类型。取值：

clb4：表示四层CLB产品。

clb7：表示七层CLB产品。

ecs：表示ECS产品。
nlb：表示NLB产品
parameters.name: resource_product

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地

AccessPortDetails.description_en: The port details of cloud service instances connected to WAF
AccessPortDetails.description_zh: 已接入WAF的云产品端口详情

items.description_en: The port details of cloud service instances connected to WAF
items.description_zh: 已接入WAF的云产品端口详情

Certificates.description_en: The list of certificates for the cloud service port connected to WAF
Certificates.description_zh: 已接入云产品端口的证书列表

items.description_en: The certificate information for the cloud service port connected to WAF
items.description_zh: 已接入云产品端口的证书信息

AppliedType.description_en:
The certificate type for the HTTPS protocol. Valid values:

default: default certificate.

extension: extension certificate
AppliedType.description_zh:
HTTPS协议的证书类型。取值：

default：表示默认证书。

extension：表示拓展证书

CertificateId.description_en: The ID of the added certificate

CipherSuite.description_en:
The cipher suite type. Valid values:

1: all cipher suites are added.

2: strong cipher suites are added. This value is available only when TLSVersion is set to tlsv1.2.

99: custom cipher suites are added. This value is available only when TLSVersion is not set to tlsv1.3
CipherSuite.description_zh:
加密套件类型。取值：

1：表示添加全部加密套件。

2：表示添加强加密套件。仅TLSVersion取值为tlsv1.2时，可选择该取值。

99：表示添加自定义加密套件。仅TLSVersion取值不为tlsv1.3时，可选择该取值

CloudResourceId.description_en: The ID of the connected resource, automatically generated by WAF
CloudResourceId.description_zh: 接入的资源ID，由WAF自动生成

CustomCiphers.description_en: The specific custom cipher suites to add. This parameter is used only when CipherSuite is set to 99
CustomCiphers.description_zh: 要添加的具体自定义加密套件。仅CipherSuite配置为99时，使用该参数

EnableTLSv3.description_en:
Indicates whether TLS 1.3 is supported. Valid values:

true: TLS 1.3 is supported.

false: TLS 1.3 is not supported.

This parameter is used only when HttpsPorts is not empty (the domain name uses the HTTPS protocol). When TLSVersion is set to tlsv1.3, this value must be true
EnableTLSv3.description_zh:
是否支持TLS1.3版本。取值：

true：表示支持TLS1.3版本。

false：表示不支持TLS1.3版本。

仅HttpsPorts取值不为空（表示域名使用HTTPS协议）时，使用该参数。当TLSVersion为tlsv1.3时，此值必须为true

Http2Enabled.description_en:
Indicates whether HTTP/2 is enabled. Valid values:

true: HTTP/2 is enabled.

false: HTTP/2 is disabled
Http2Enabled.description_zh:
是否开启HTTP2。取值：

true：表示开启HTTP2。

false：表示不开启HTTP2

Keepalive.description_en:
Indicates whether keep-alive connections are enabled. Valid values:

true (default): Keep-alive connections are enabled.

false: Keep-alive connections are disabled
Keepalive.description_zh:
是否保持长连接。取值：

true（默认）：表示保持长连接。

false：表示不保持长连接

KeepaliveRequests.description_en:
The number of requests that can reuse a keep-alive connection. Valid values: 60 to 1000.

Specifies how many requests can reuse a keep-alive connection after keep-alive is enabled
KeepaliveRequests.description_zh:
复用长连接的请求个数。取值范围：60~1000，单位：个。

开启长连接后，复用多少个长连接

KeepaliveTimeout.description_en:
The idle timeout period for keep-alive connections. Valid values: 10 to 3600. Default value: 15. Unit: seconds.

Specifies how long an idle keep-alive connection remains open before it is released
KeepaliveTimeout.description_zh:
空闲长连接超时时间，取值范围：10~3600，默认15，单位：秒。

复用的长连接空闲多久后释放

LogHeaders.description_en:
The traffic tag fields and values of the domain name, used to mark traffic processed by WAF.

This parameter is returned only when the traffic tag feature is enabled for the domain name
LogHeaders.description_zh:
域名的流量标记字段和值，用于标记经过WAF处理的流量。

仅当域名开启了流量标记功能时，返回该参数

items.description_en:
The traffic tag fields and values of the domain name, used to mark traffic processed by WAF.

This parameter is returned only when the traffic tag feature is enabled for the domain name
items.description_zh:
域名的流量标记字段和值，用于标记经过WAF处理的流量。

仅当域名开启了流量标记功能时，返回该参数

Key.description_en: The specified custom request header field
Key.description_zh: 指定的自定义请求头部字段

Value.description_en: The value set for the specified custom request header field
Value.description_zh: 指定的自定义请求头部字段设定的值

MaxBodySize.description_en: The maximum request body size. Valid values: 2 to 10. Default value: 2. Unit: GB
MaxBodySize.description_zh: 最大请求体大小。取值范围：2~10，默认值：2，单位：G
MaxBodySize.title_en: 最大请求体大小。取值范围：2~10，默认值：2，单位：G。
MaxBodySize.title_zh: 最大请求体大小。取值范围：2~10，默认值：2，单位：G。

OwnerUserId.description_en: The UID of the cloud service resource ownership

Port.description_en: The port of the cloud service that is connected to WAF

Protocol.description_en:
The protocol type. Valid values:
http: HTTP protocol.
https: HTTPS protocol
Protocol.description_zh:
协议类型。取值：
http：表示HTTP协议。
https：表示HTTPS协议

ReadTimeout.description_en:
The read timeout period, in seconds.
Valid values: 1 to 3600
ReadTimeout.description_zh:
读超时时长，单位：秒。
取值范围：1~3600

Status.description_en:
The domain name status. Valid values:

1: The port is in a normal state.

2: The port is being created.

3: The port is being modified.

4: The port is being released
Status.description_zh:
域名状态。取值：

1：表示端口处于正常状态。

2：表示端口创建中。

3：表示端口修改中。

4：表示端口释放中

SubStatus.description_en:
The protection exception status. Valid values:

InvalidCert: invalid certificate.

ClientCertOpend: mutual authentication is enabled.
NetworkConfigLost: cloud service network configuration exception
SubStatus.description_zh:
防护异常状态。取值：

InvalidCert：表示无效证书。

ClientCertOpend：表示开启双写认证。
NetworkConfigLost：表示云产品网络配置异常

SubStatusDetails.description_en: The specific reasons for the protection exception status. This parameter has a value only when SubStatus is set to InvalidCert
SubStatusDetails.description_zh: 防护异常状态具体原因，仅在SubStatus为InvalidCert时有值

items.description_en: The specific reasons for the protection exception status. This parameter has a value only when SubStatus is set to InvalidCert
items.description_zh: 防护异常状态具体原因，仅在SubStatus为InvalidCert时有值

AppliedType.description_en:
The certificate type for the HTTPS protocol. Valid values:

default: default certificate.

extension: extension certificate
AppliedType.description_zh:
HTTPS协议的证书类型。取值：

default：表示默认证书。

extension：表示拓展证书

CertId.description_en: The certificate ID in SSL Certificates Service

CertName.description_en: The certificate name in SSL Certificates Service

Domain.description_en: The domain name bound to the certificate

ExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the certificate, in UNIX timestamp format. Unit: seconds
ExpireTime.description_zh: 证书的过期时间，格式为Unix时间戳，单位：秒

ProductCertId.description_en: The certificate ID stored in the cloud service

ProductCertName.description_en: The certificate name stored in the cloud service
ProductCertName.description_zh: 云产品保存的证书名称

ReasonCode.description_en:
The specific reason for the protection exception status. Valid values:

UserUploadCert: The certificate was manually uploaded.

CertNotExistInCertCenter: The certificate does not exist in SSL Certificates Service.
CertExpired: The cloud certificate has expired.
EmptyCertCN: The CN of the certificate is empty
ReasonCode.description_zh:
防护异常状态的具体原因。取值：

UserUploadCert：表示手工上传证书。

CertNotExistInCertCenter：表示在证书SSL证书中心不存在。
CertExpired：表示云证书已过期。
EmptyCertCN：表示证书的CN为空

TLSVersion.description_en:
The TLS version. Valid values:

tlsv1: Supports TLS 1.0 and later. Highest compatibility, lower security.

tlsv1.1: Supports TLS 1.1 and later. Good compatibility, good security.

tlsv1.2: Supports TLS 1.2 and later. Good compatibility, highest security.

tlsv1.3: Supports only TLS 1.3. Highest security, lower compatibility
TLSVersion.description_zh:
TLS的版本。取值：

tlsv1(支持TLS1.0及以上版本，兼容性最高，安全性较低。)

tlsv1.1(支持TLS1.1及以上版本，兼容性较好，安全性较好。)

tlsv1.2(支持TLS1.2及以上版本，兼容性较好，安全性最高。)

tlsv1.3(仅支持 TLS 1.3版本，安全性最高，兼容性较低。)

WriteTimeout.description_en:
The write timeout period, in seconds.
Valid values: 1 to 3600
WriteTimeout.description_zh:
写超时时长，单位：秒。
取值范围：1~3600

XffHeaderMode.description_en:
The method that WAF uses to obtain the originating IP address of the client. Valid values:

0: The client traffic does not pass through any Layer 7 proxy before reaching WAF.

1: WAF reads the first value in the X-Forwarded-For (XFF) header as the client IP address.

2: WAF reads the value of a custom header field that you specify as the client IP address.

3: WAF reads the Client IP from the Proxy Protocol header as the client IP address
XffHeaderMode.description_zh:
WAF获取客户端真实IP的方式。取值：

0：表示客户端访问流量到WAF前没有经过其他七层代理转发。

1：表示WAF读取请求头中X-Forwarded-For（XFF）字段的第一个值作为客户端IP。

2：表示WAF读取请求头中由您设置的自定义字段值作为客户端IP。

3：表示WAF读取Proxy Protocol头中的Client IP作为客户端IP

XffHeaders.description_en:
The list of custom header fields used to obtain the client IP address, in the format ["header1","header2",……].

This parameter is required only when XffHeaderMode is set to 2 (WAF reads the value of a custom header field that you specify as the client IP address)
XffHeaders.description_zh:
设置用于获取客户端IP的自定义字段列表，使用["header1","header2",……]格式表示。

仅在XffHeaderMode取值为2（表示WAF读取请求头中由您设置的自定义字段值作为客户端IP）时，需要设置该参数

items.description_en:
The list of custom header fields used to obtain the client IP address, in the format ["header1","header2",……].

This parameter is required only when XffHeaderMode is set to 2 (WAF reads the value of a custom header field that you specify as the client IP address)
items.description_zh:
设置用于获取客户端IP的自定义字段列表，使用["header1","header2",……]格式表示。

仅在XffHeaderMode取值为2（表示WAF读取请求头中由您设置的自定义字段值作为客户端IP）时，需要设置该参数

XffProto.description_en:
Specifies whether the X-Forward-For-Proto header passes the WAF protocol. Valid values:

true (default): The WAF protocol is passed.

false: The WAF protocol is not passed
XffProto.description_zh:
X-Forward-For-Proto传递WAF的协议。取值：

true（默认）：表示传递WAF的协议。

false：表示不传递WAF的协议

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
